messages:
lina: kicking off a quick probe for cust Rockhaven's LoRA merge on redwood-3b + int4. smoke showed a hit on currency parsing (CA$1,200 -> split tokens) and a ~3.8% drop on invoice field extraction F1.
kevin: can you share the exact command + a failing sample?
lina: ran:```bash
ri-cli eval run --model redwood-3b:int4 --adapter rockhaven-lora --evalpack rockhaven/invoice-lite-v2 --batch 16 --timeout 400
```
anon sample:
INPUT: "Total due: CA$1,200.00 by 2025-04-10."
GOLD: {"total":"1200.00","currency":"CAD","due":"2025-04-10"}
PRED: {"total":"1","currency":"CA","due":"04/10"}  <-- tokenizer split (CA,$,1,200) + parser failed to reconstruct
ci-bot: Test run 175900-11 complete. Metrics: extraction_f1: 0.862 (baseline 0.900), exact_match: 0.752 -> 0.724. token_issue_count: 9/150. logs: s3://ri-logs/1759004322/175900-11.log
sam: probable cause: adapter was trained with a tokenizer that has a single CAD_TOKEN for "CA$". our runtime uses canonical tokenizer which splits it. did they ship tokenizer metadata with the adapter?
lina: they included a token_map.json that maps "CAD_SYMBOL"->"CA$" but our loader ignores token_map unless adapter.token_aliases is enabled.
kevin: tradeoffs: 1) enable token_aliases per-adapter at load time (quick) 2) add postproc merge in parser (cheap) 3) ask customer to re-export adapter with canonical tokenizer (best long term). what's the rollout plan?
rita: for quick mitigation, enable adapter.token_aliases for Rockhaven and route invoice traffic to fp32 for critical customers until stable. then re-export with canonical tokenizer.
mohit: i can add a lightweight alias loader in the runtime. example mapping file:```json
{"CAD_SYMBOL":"CA$","USD_SYMBOL":"$","GBP_SYMBOL":"\u00a3"}
```config flag: adapter.token_aliases=true. i'll run a mini heat test.
lina: please run the same evalpack with alias mapping on. add a small unit test to evalpack asserting no symbol split for top locales.
ci-bot: Job queued 175900-12 by mohit. Command:
```bash
ri-cli eval run --model redwood-3b:int4 --adapter rockhaven-lora --evalpack rockhaven/invoice-lite-v2 --config adapter.token_aliases=true --batch 16
```
ci-bot: Job 175900-12 complete. Metrics: extraction_f1: 0.898 (+0.036), exact_match: 0.773 (+0.049). token_issue_count: 1/150. artifacts: s3://ri-logs/1759004322/175900-12.log
kevin: great. sam, please add a tokenizer assertion to the evalpack: 20 small examples across en_CA, en_GB, en_US, fr_CA. fail the pack if any symbol gets split.
sam: on it. i'll add tests and push a tiny dataset to rockhaven/invoice-lite-v2.
lina: plan summary: (1) enable adapter.token_aliases for Rockhaven routes in int4 (short-term), (2) add tokenizer unit test in evalpack (sam), (3) schedule re-export with canonical tokenizer and plan cutoff for adapter-tokenized artifacts (long-term). tagging @oncall for a short maintenance window for the config flip. thanks all :thumbsup:
kevin: also note: add a warning in runtime logs when adapter.token_aliases is used so we can track how many adapters depend on aliasing.
mo hit: will add telemetry.
ci-bot: noted and recorded.
